<!-- pr-reviewer: 2c049d69d0683cb47458cd311b2eb8c54589e893 -->

Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.

## What looks good

- The region law is the right one: for a pocket-family op with the stock source, `stock_pocket` builds the stock outline minus every part section that stands at the ladder planes. This is the same island law as the whole-model source (#12).
- The degenerate cases answer cleanly. No part in the setup: the function returns `None` and the old region stands, byte for byte. A part fully outside the stock: nothing stands inside, so `minus_standing` returns `None` the same way. Parts that fill the whole stock outline at a plane: generate refuses by name with the Z value in the message. No path passes silently with a full-coverage region.
- No new panic paths. The new code has no `unwrap()` or `expect()`. Heights and slice errors return `Err` through `?` and `map_err`. `ladder_planes` guards a non-finite or zero span, a zero step, and caps the walk at 100 000 planes.
- The pinning test proves the part stays. `a_stock_source_clearing_goes_around_the_part_and_posts` asserts no blocking warning, no feed point whose tool centre overlaps the block or boss section below its top, and a posted program - on both stocks, for 2D Pocket and 2D Adaptive. The MCP test now expects 0 gouges and `verify ok` for the stock source, and still expects a conviction for an offset into the part.
- `area.rs` is 390 lines after the change. The new code sits in `crates/app/src/operation/area.rs` and reads the ECS world, so `app` is the right crate.
- The body is complete: `Changelog:` line, `Fixes #1554`, decision file, conventional commit.

## Results

Ran on the self-hosted runner through pr-test.yml: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/43589975114

- Trial merge with main `57bdcf65037c2e9f872ae9e2f15e628f20306cf7`: clean, 4 files differ. The PR head did not move during the run.
- Quick gate on the merged tree: 0 failed, 3.9 min wall. It ran the whole `keep_law` suite, plus `whole_model_pocket`, `area_controls`, `pocket_overhead`, `neighbour_law` and 13 more app suites in one cargo call.
- Clippy `-p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- I also checked `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main 2c049d69d` from the review machine: clean.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Notes (not blocking)

- `crates/app/src/operation/job.rs` is 459 lines. It was already over ~400; this PR adds 4 lines to it. The split should ride the next change that touches it.
- Known limit, same as #12: the islands are the union over all ladder planes, so a level above the part top leaves stock over the part. This leaves material; it never cuts the part.
- The tilted (3+2) frame path of `stock_pocket` has no test. The PR names this under "Not exercised".
- The issue's second finding (a model-source adaptive that skips a band narrower than the tool) goes to #1655. The split is sound; a note there can move CL goldens.
- The runner checked the Linux arm only. The diff adds no `cfg(windows)` or per-OS pinned reading, so no local Windows run was owed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
